```yaml
name: Dependency Review
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  dependency-review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run dependency review
        uses: github/dependency-review-action@v2
        with:
          fail-on-severity: high
```
